problem.title: Gas Station Circuit
problem.problemStatement: There are N gas stations arranged in a circle. Each station provides a certain amount of gas, and traveling to the next station consumes a certain amount of gas. Determine the starting station index from which the entire circuit can be completed. If impossible, print -1.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers representing gas available. • Third line contains N integers representing travel cost.
problem.output: Print the starting station index or -1.
